pages.title: Flat-Headed Peccary
pages.text: The flat-headed peccary ($(o)Platygonus compressus$()) is an extinct peccary that lived across much of North America during the Pleistocene, until about 11,000 years ago.$(br2)It was larger and longer-legged than living peccaries, built for travelling across open country.$(br2)Many skeletons are often found together in caves in Kentucky, Missouri and Texas, suggesting that it lived in herds that included both sexes and all ages.
